def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    A = [0] + data[1:1 + n]
    F = [0] + data[1 + n:1 + 2 * n]
    del data

    root = n + 1
    nxt = [root] * (n + 2)
    stack = []

    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        ai = A[i]
        while stack and A[stack[-1]] <= ai:
            stack.pop()
        if stack:
            nxt[i] = stack[-1]
        else:
            nxt[i] = root
        stack.append(i)

    LOG = (n + 2).bit_length()
    up = [[root] * (n + 2) for _ in range(LOG)]

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        up[0][i] = nxt[i]
    up[0][root] = root

    for j in range(1, LOG):
        prev = up[j - 1]
        curr = up[j]
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            curr[i] = prev[prev[i]]
        curr[root] = root

    depth = [0] * (n + 2)
    prefA = [0] * (n + 2)
    prefC = [0] * (n + 2)

    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        p = nxt[i]
        depth[i] = depth[p] + 1
        prefA[i] = A[i] + prefA[p]
        prefC[i] = depth[i] * A[i] + prefC[p]

    ans = []

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        f = F[i]
        s = i + 1

        if s > n or depth[s] < f:
            ans.append("-1")
            continue

        anc = s
        d = f
        bit = 0
        while d:
            if d & 1:
                anc = up[bit][anc]
            d >>= 1
            bit += 1

        t0 = prefA[s] - prefA[anc]
        td = prefC[s] - prefC[anc]
        res = (f - depth[s]) * t0 + td
        ans.append(str(res))

    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
